snippets.snippet_text: "Speaking of alternatives, there aren't any depending on your country. Where I live (Brazil), they only accept PayPal. No bank accounts, no Stripe. I've been wanting to use any of the other two options for years now (they are cheaper), and asked their support about it many times, but always replied something along the lines of 'we are working on it'."
